_: Node contract of this element (step 417): what the node needs to install, run and manage it. Read by the node core only; never served to the outside. The public description is OWN-SERVICE-PROPS/.

port.note: A wish, not a decision. The node assigns the actual port from the block 24680-25679. Ask the node, never remember.

env.note: Next reads .env.local by its own convention.

health.note: { ok: true } without a key — the watcher's door. /api/health of the template answers too.

runtime.startNote: The standalone server reads PORT and HOSTNAME from the environment. The installer finds server.js under .next/standalone and copies .next/static next to it.
runtime.distDirNote: The node builds into a neighbour folder named by this variable while the old build serves, then switches: no downtime. A replacement that does not declare it is stopped for the build.

settings.note: The site owns its settings; the node core reads and patches them through this door and rebuilds the site. Without the door the core leaves this site's settings alone.

contract: Takes its port from the environment; never remembers a number.
Answers GET /health and GET /api/health with 200 without a key.
Keeps the vectors of the node in its own file: the one named exception to «stored data only through the data element» — it IS the vector part of the data layer.
Its doors answer only programs of this machine: through the tunnel they answer 404 even with a key.
Uses the same lock as the database element (the node data key or a privileged session).
Never changes the model or the size of embeddings on a live store: the stored vectors would become unreadable.
Public pages stay static: no force-dynamic, no cookies() or headers() in a layout or a page.
Reads its own name from this passport at start (lib/own-id.ts); no name of the element is written in its code.

languages.note: en is the base, ru the translation; the set is this site's own setting (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES, kind own).

auth.note: Every door but /health requires the node data key (shared by the three storage elements) or a privileged session (architect, admin, agent) through the node sign-in element. A request through the Cloudflare tunnel (cf-ray) gets 404 on every data door, with a key or without.

storage.file: data/vectors.db in the element folder (VECTORS_DB_PATH overrides)
storage.schema: executed at start, no migrations; the index is derived data and is rebuilt when it holds fewer rows than the table

doors.gives: the public home page of the element
the doors of this element, the model and size of embeddings

the nearest records { collection?, query | embedding, k ≤ 100 } with a cosine score
whether the key is set, model, dimensions, index mode, number of records

a2a.note: A native element of the node: it serves the node through its doors, not the network.
